title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 94
paragraphs: The Ionians furnished a hundred ships and were equipped like Greeks. The Ionians, during the long time they lived in the Peloponnese, in the country now called Achaea, and before Danaus and Xuthus came to the Peloponnese, were called, as the Greeks report, Pelasgians of the Coast, and then were called Ionians after Ion son of Xuthus.
